title: Slow Caramel with Explicit Completion Criteria

ingredients.label: unsalted butter
ingredients.source_text: 60 g unsalted butter, cut into six pieces

operations.until: Until every visible crystal has disappeared from both the syrup and the inner wall of the pan, and the liquid is completely transparent when viewed against a white spatula
Until the syrup is an even deep amber from edge to center, gives off the first faint thread of smoke, and has not developed any dark bitter spots

operations.action: carefully whisk in dairy and seasoning

outputs.label: smooth salted caramel sauce with a deep amber finish

operations.until: Until bubbling has subsided, every piece of butter is incorporated, and a spoonful cools to a thick ribbon that remains smooth rather than grainy

ambiguities: No separate yield statement is visible.
The visible words “medium” and “low” appear to be heat settings rather than measured temperatures.
No pan size or caramel batch volume is shown.
evidence_notes: Sugar and water first form a completely clear concentrated sugar syrup.
That syrup alone flows into the caramelize operation before butter, cream, and salt join at the final operation.
All three operation boxes show explicit heat or timing information, and each shows a long completion criterion.
